text:
Ethan: Hey team, new hire here. I'm trying to finish cloud setup and hit a few blockers: can't link project to billing and KMS key creation fails with PERMISSION_DENIED. Project is redwood-eu-experiments and I need to spin up a small GKE cluster in europe-west1 and configure a KMS key for secrets. Also need AWS access to push images to eu ECR. Who should I ping to get the right roles?
onboarding-bot: Welcome Ethan :wave: please follow the onboarding checklist at https://redwood.example/onboarding-eu and ping cloud-ops for perms.

Lina - cloud-ops: Hi Ethan 2b welcome! Can you paste the gcloud command and error you saw? Also what's your Okta email so I can find your identity?

Ethan: Command was `gcloud kms keys create ci-secrets-key --location=global --keyring=ci-keyring --project=redwood-eu-experiments` and error: `PERMISSION_DENIED: Resource has been blocked by org policy: constraints/gcpkms.disableSymmetricKeyCreation` (approx). Okta is ethan@redwood.com.

Lina - cloud-ops: Hmm looks like that folder has a stricter org-policy blocking symmetric keys in some sandboxes. Two options: I can request a policy exception for that project (takes 1-2 days), or I can create a customer-managed key in our infra KMS project and grant your service account cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter rights. Which do you need faster?

Ethan: Fast please, the CI deployment needs the key this week. Creating the key in infra KMS is fine.

Priya - security: Quick note: if you use infra KMS, we'll need to ensure the key's usage and audit logs are recorded and that the key policy restricts access to the SA only. Also, if any data is regulated, we have to ensure the key's location complies (EU residency). We'll set that to europe-west3 if needed.

Ethan: Cool, europe-west3 residency is fine. Also separately `gcloud beta billing projects link redwood-eu-experiments --billing-account=BILL-EU-02` returned `PERMISSION_DENIED`.

Alex - finance: For billing links, finance needs project id, cost center, and manager approval. Cost center for Ethan's org is CC-ENG-EU7. Please put an approval note in the infra ticket and estimate spend if > $150/month. Once we have that I'll link BILL-EU-02.

Tomas - infra: I can pre-provision the SA, grant it least-privilege roles for GKE and KMS, and create the infra KMS key in europe-west3. Ethan, do you need `gke-cluster-admin` or just `container.developer` for the CI service account?

Ethan: Just container.developer + compute.viewer to create node pools is fine. Also need AWS side: pushing images to eu-west-1 ECR. What's the process?

Tomas - infra: For AWS we'll create a cross-account role `Redwood-EU-CICD` in infra AWS account and allow `sts:AssumeRole` from your Okta principal `okta/ethan@redwood.com`. Send me your Okta principal and I'll open a ticket to create the role.

Ethan: Okta principal is okta/ethan@redwood.com. Thanks all, I'll file the infra ticket with the cost-center note and manager approval, and reply here once done. Appreciate the quick help :tada:
